name: Postsynaptic actin remodeling and dendrite arborization
rationale: All members concern structural organization of dendrites and the postsynapse (spines, PSD, postsynaptic actin, arborization), distinguished from confusables by PSD maintenance, postsynapse assembly and arborization rather than NMDAR-RAC1, filopodia or receptor trafficking.

name: NGF signaling through TRKA and p75NTR
rationale: Members cover NGF production, TRKA activation and downstream cascades plus p75NTR survival/death signalling, which separates the theme from confusables centred on BDNF/NT3 signalling through NTRK2 and NTRK3.

name: SLC4 bicarbonate transport and CO2 hydration
rationale: Members concern bicarbonate handling via SLC4 transporters (and their acidosis-causing defects) and carbonic-anhydrase CO2 hydration, unlike confusables on organelle acidification, SLC26 anion exchange or phosphate transport.

name: ESCRT-mediated viral budding and multivesicular body formation
rationale: Members share ESCRT-driven outward membrane budding and fission (HIV/viral release, MVB and exosome formation), distinguished from confusables using ESCRT-III in abscission and nuclear envelope sealing or in receptor endocytosis.

name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin de novo protein folding
rationale: Members concern CCT/TRiC-assisted de novo folding and complex assembly of nascent proteins such as actin and tubulin, lacking the prefoldin, post-chaperonin, ER folding and aggrephagy members of the confusables.

name: RUNX, AP-2 and HOX transcription factor programs
rationale: Every member is a transcriptional program of the RUNX, TFAP2 (AP-2) or HOX-cluster transcription factor families, and the AP-2 and HOX members distinguish it from confusables limited to RUNX1 in haematopoiesis and granulopoiesis.

name: Vasculogenesis and arterial-venous endothelial differentiation
rationale: Members concern endothelial cell differentiation and formation and maturation of arterial, venous, aortic and CNS vessels, unlike confusables centred on BMP-driven cardiac/pulmonary artery development, lymphatic fate or coronary vasculogenesis.

qualifier: type 2 mast cell and eosinophil immunity
name: Cytokine JAK-STAT signaling and type 2 allergic immunity
rationale: Members span interleukin and interferon receptor signalling together with FcepsilonRI mast cell, eosinophil, Th2 and IgE responses, which distinguishes the theme from confusables focused on IL-17/IL-36 or narrower T cell cytokine programs.

name: Gastrulation, mesoderm specification and early heart field development
rationale: Members concern primitive streak, EMT and mesendoderm/mesoderm formation during gastrulation plus cardiogenesis and secondary heart field specification, unlike confusables centred on lateral plate/endoderm derivatives, pluripotency factors or heart tube morphogenesis.

name: Fructose 2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis and lactate fermentation
rationale: Members concern fructose 2,6-bisphosphate control of glycolysis and its lactate-producing end, distinguishing the theme from confusables on glucagon/glycogen control, p53/mTORC1 metabolic regulation or hexokinase-level glucose catabolism.

name: Lysosome-related organelle biogenesis and melanin pigmentation
rationale: Members concern biogenesis and cargo loading of lysosome-related organelles (melanosomes, platelet dense granules) and melanin pigmentation, unlike confusables on lysosomal enzyme targeting, organelle acidification or UV-driven melanocyte responses.

core: Golgi organization and small GTPase regulation
name: Golgi ribbon dynamics and Rho-family GTPase regulation
rationale: Members combine Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and positioning with Rho/RHOBTB/Ral GTPase cycles and effectors, distinguishing the theme from confusables centred on Golgi vesicle budding, membrane tubulation and Rab/ARF trafficking.

name: Mammary, pancreatic, gonadal and reproductive tract development
rationale: Members concern development of mammary gland, pancreas, gonads and sex determination, prostate and female/male reproductive tract, unlike confusables centred on lung, salivary and kidney branching morphogenesis.

name: VWF-GPIb platelet adhesion, activation and degranulation
rationale: Members concern platelet adhesion via VWF and GPIb-IX-V (including VWF/ADAMTS13 variants), activation, degranulation and coagulation, unlike confusables centred on ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and GPVI receptor signalling.

name: Solute carrier transport of carnitine and carboxylates
rationale: Members concern SLC-mediated transport of organic anions such as carnitine, succinate and di/tricarboxylates including the malate-aspartate shuttle, unlike confusables on TCA/pyruvate metabolism, cationic amino acid transport or glutamate metabolism.

name: Peptide antigen presentation via MHC II and cross-presentation
rationale: Members concern processing of peptide antigens for MHC class II and for MHC class I cross-presentation via phagosome/endosome routes, unlike confusables on CD1 lipid antigen and TLR7/8 or on classical class I loading in the ER.

name: Regulation of collateral sprouting and neurite regeneration
rationale: All members concern positive or negative control of axon collateral sprouting and neuron projection regeneration, unlike confusables on axon guidance, Sema3A/ephrin repulsion or injured-axon regeneration signalling.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide metabolism and nitric oxide
name: Hydrogen peroxide and nitrosative stress responses
rationale: Members concern cellular responses to hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxides, nitric oxide and reactive nitrogen species and control of H2O2 production and breakdown, unlike confusables on general ROS detoxification, BACH1/MTF1 regulation or oxidative cell death.

qualifier: palmitoylation, GPI anchoring and glycosphingolipid synthesis
name: Protein palmitoylation, GPI anchoring and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members concern lipid attachment to proteins (cysteine palmitoylation, Hedgehog autoprocessing and lipidation, GPI anchor synthesis and attachment) together with glycosphingolipid synthesis, whereas confusables carry either only the Hedgehog/RAS processing side or glycolipid transport.

name: Ear development and auditory-vestibular hair cell function
rationale: Members concern morphogenesis of the inner, middle and outer ear, hair cell specification and stereocilia, and auditory and vestibular mechanosensation, unlike confusables on eye/lens development, microvilli or cranial nerve and olfactory development.

qualifier: maternal mRNA clearance and piRNA genome defense
name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and piRNA germline genome defense
rationale: Members concern oocyte construction, maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation and zygotic epigenetic programming together with piRNA biogenesis and transposon silencing, unlike confusables limited to mRNA deadenylation or centred on spermatogenesis and primordial germ cells.

qualifier: endothelial activation and vascular wound healing
name: Vascular remodeling, endothelial activation and vascular wound healing
rationale: Members concern remodeling and repair of the vessel wall: endothelial activation, proliferation, tube formation and apoptosis, smooth muscle adaptation and vascular wound healing, unlike confusables centred on VEGF/Tie angiogenic signalling, shear stress and SMC phenotype, or leukocyte adhesion.

name: LXR/SREBP/PPARA transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism
rationale: Members concern LXR, SREBP, PPARA and PGC-1alpha transcriptional regulation of lipogenesis, triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis and gluconeogenesis, unlike confusables centred on adipocyte differentiation or circadian nuclear receptors.

name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signaling to CREB
rationale: Members concern adenylate cyclase activation (including dopamine receptor and forskolin), cAMP response, PKA activation and CREB phosphorylation, unlike confusables on cAMP degradation/DARPP-32 or CaMK-driven CREB and MECP2 signalling.

name: Regulation of gliogenesis and oligodendrocyte differentiation
rationale: Members concern glial fate specification, proliferation, migration and differentiation of oligodendrocytes, astrocytes and Schwann cells, unlike confusables centred on CNS myelin maintenance and gliosis or on Bergmann glia and neuronal precursor proliferation.
